title: Among players taller than 180 cm whose attributes were recorded between 201
question: Among players taller than 180 cm whose attributes were recorded between 2012 and 2014, find those whose overall rating is above the average overall rating of all such players. Return their names in descending order of overall rating.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_123"
FROM Player AS T1
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1."XCL_122" = T2."XCL_130"
WHERE T1."XCL_126" > 180
  AND T2."XCL_131" BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
  AND T2."XCL_132" > (
    SELECT AVG(T2b."XCL_132")
    FROM Player AS T1b
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_122" = T2b."XCL_130"
    WHERE T1b."XCL_126" > 180
      AND T2b."XCL_131" BETWEEN '2012-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
  )
ORDER BY T2."XCL_132" DESC
